#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run existing CLI/API owners, preserving exact provenance and failed results."""
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, time
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('phase', choices=['load', 'smoke', 'reference', 'matrix'])
parser.add_argument('--binary', type=pathlib.Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--sha256', required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
manifest = json.loads((root/'manifest.json').read_text())
state = pathlib.Path(manifest['state'])
binary = args.binary.resolve()
actual_hash = hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert actual_hash == args.sha256, 'wrong checkpoint binary'
assert os.environ.get('SYMBOLICA_LICENSE'), 'supply SYMBOLICA_LICENSE explicitly'
record = {'phase': args.phase, 'binary': str(binary), 'binary_sha256': actual_hash,
          'source_commit': manifest['source_commit'], 'runs': []}
result_path = root/f'{args.phase}.results.json'
assert not result_path.exists(), 'refusing to overwrite existing evidence'
if args.phase in ['reference','matrix']:
    for prerequisite in (['load','smoke'] if args.phase == 'reference' else ['load','smoke','reference']):
        prior = json.loads((root/f'{prerequisite}.results.json').read_text())
        assert prior['binary_sha256'] == actual_hash and prior['passed'], prerequisite+' gate did not pass for this binary'

def invoke(name, command):
    log = root/f'{name}.log'
    assert not log.exists(), 'refusing to overwrite '+str(log)
    started = time.monotonic()
    with log.open('w') as output:
        process = subprocess.run(command, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    run = {'name':name,'argv':command,'exit_code':process.returncode,
           'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'log':str(log),
           'log_sha256':hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    record['runs'].append(run)
    record['passed'] = all(item['exit_code']==0 for item in record['runs'])
    result_path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(run), flush=True)
    if process.returncode:
        raise SystemExit('failed; exact evidence retained: '+str(log))

for profile in manifest['profiles']:
    card = manifest['cards'][profile]['path']
    assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(card).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == manifest['cards'][profile]['sha256'], 'card differs from prepared manifest'
    boot = [str(binary),'--read-only-state','--no-save-state','-s',str(state),card]
    if args.phase == 'load':
        invoke(f'load_{profile}',boot+['display','integrand','-p',manifest['process'],'-i','default','--category','orientation'])
    elif args.phase == 'reference':
        invoke(f'reference_{profile}',[str(root/'reference_driver'),str(state),str(root/f'{profile}.runtime-overlay.toml'),'8192',str(root/f'reference_{profile}')])
        assert json.loads((root/f'reference_{profile}.json').read_text())['passed']
    else:
        seeds = [101] if args.phase == 'smoke' else manifest['seeds']
        for seed in seeds:
            name = f'{args.phase}_{profile}_seed{seed}'
            workspace = root/name
            assert not workspace.exists(), 'require a fresh workspace'
            n = 64 if args.phase == 'smoke' else 10000
            start = 64 if args.phase == 'smoke' else 2000
            invoke(name,boot+['run','integrate','-D',f'seed={seed}','-D','power=2.0','-D',f'n_start={start}','-D',f'n_max={n}','-D','cores=1','-D',f'workspace={workspace}'])
record['changed_state_files'] = [relative for relative, expected in manifest['state_hashes'].items()
    if hashlib.sha256((state/relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected]
record['state_unchanged'] = not record['changed_state_files']
record['passed'] = record['state_unchanged']
result_path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')

assert record['passed'], 'input state changed; evidence retained'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
: "${X1_TARGET:?Set exact3f9 dev-optim target directory}"
cd /tmp/advanced-sampling-amplitude-matrix/x1_3f9b1a284_box_rest
# Reuse the exact gated libraries from the CLI build; no Cargo or new evaluator.
args=()
: > reference_libraries.sha256
for crate in gammaloop_api gammalooprs figment toml color_eyre; do
    lib=$(find "$X1_TARGET/deps" -maxdepth 1 -name "lib${crate}*.rlib" -printf "%T@ %p\n" | sort -nr | head -1 | cut -d" " -f2-)
    args+=(--extern "$crate=$lib")
    sha256sum "$lib" >> reference_libraries.sha256
done
rustc --edition=2021 -C opt-level=1 -C debuginfo=0 -L "dependency=$X1_TARGET/deps" "${args[@]}" reference_driver.rs -o reference_driver
sha256sum reference_driver reference_driver.rs > reference_driver.sha256

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run existing CLI/API owners, preserving exact provenance and failed results."""
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, time
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('phase', choices=['load', 'smoke', 'reference', 'matrix'])
parser.add_argument('--binary', type=pathlib.Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--sha256', required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
manifest = json.loads((root/'manifest.json').read_text())
state = pathlib.Path(manifest['state'])
binary = args.binary.resolve()
actual_hash = hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert actual_hash == args.sha256, 'wrong checkpoint binary'
assert os.environ.get('SYMBOLICA_LICENSE'), 'supply SYMBOLICA_LICENSE explicitly'
record = {'phase': args.phase, 'binary': str(binary), 'binary_sha256': actual_hash,
          'source_commit': manifest['source_commit'], 'runs': []}
result_path = root/f'{args.phase}.results.json'
assert not result_path.exists(), 'refusing to overwrite existing evidence'
if args.phase in ['reference','matrix']:
    for prerequisite in (['load','smoke'] if args.phase == 'reference' else ['load','smoke','reference']):
        prior = json.loads((root/f'{prerequisite}.results.json').read_text())
        assert prior['binary_sha256'] == actual_hash and prior['passed'], prerequisite+' gate did not pass for this binary'

def invoke(name, command):
    log = root/f'{name}.log'
    assert not log.exists(), 'refusing to overwrite '+str(log)
    started = time.monotonic()
    with log.open('w') as output:
        process = subprocess.run(command, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    run = {'name':name,'argv':command,'exit_code':process.returncode,
           'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'log':str(log),
           'log_sha256':hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    record['runs'].append(run)
    record['passed'] = all(item['exit_code']==0 for item in record['runs'])
    result_path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(run), flush=True)
    if process.returncode:
        raise SystemExit('failed; exact evidence retained: '+str(log))

for profile in manifest['profiles']:
    card = manifest['cards'][profile]['path']
    assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(card).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == manifest['cards'][profile]['sha256'], 'card differs from prepared manifest'
    boot = [str(binary),'--read-only-state','--no-save-state','-s',str(state),card]
    if args.phase == 'load':
        invoke(f'load_{profile}',boot+['display','integrand','-p','massive_kite','-i','default','--category','orientation'])
    elif args.phase == 'reference':
        invoke(f'reference_{profile}',[str(root/'reference_driver'),str(state),str(root/f'{profile}.runtime-overlay.toml'),'8192',str(root/f'reference_{profile}')])
        assert json.loads((root/f'reference_{profile}.json').read_text())['passed']
    else:
        seeds = [101] if args.phase == 'smoke' else manifest['seeds']
        for seed in seeds:
            name = f'{args.phase}_{profile}_seed{seed}'
            workspace = root/name
            assert not workspace.exists(), 'require a fresh workspace'
            n = 64 if args.phase == 'smoke' else 10000
            start = 64 if args.phase == 'smoke' else 2000
            invoke(name,boot+['run','integrate','-D',f'seed={seed}','-D','power=2.0','-D',f'n_start={start}','-D',f'n_max={n}','-D','cores=1','-D',f'workspace={workspace}'])
record['changed_state_files'] = [relative for relative, expected in manifest['state_hashes'].items()
    if hashlib.sha256((state/relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected]
record['state_unchanged'] = not record['changed_state_files']
record['passed'] = record['state_unchanged']
result_path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')

assert record['passed'], 'input state changed; evidence retained'

: > reference_libraries.sha256
